messages:
sophia: Quick pulse on the GPTQ mini bake across Llama2-13B, Mistral-7B, Qwen-7B. Ran small eval suites (MMLU / HellaSwag / CodeEval) and a curated hallucination check. TL;DR below and S3 link from bakebot.
sophia: TL;DR: Llama2 GPTQ shows modest accuracy drop but big cost win; Mistral very stable; Qwen has the largest quality delta and a few formatting edgecases. Recommend selective canary for Qwen.
jamal: where are the raw logs / CSVs?
bakebot: results uploaded -> s3://redwood-eval/gptq/pulse-3976543210/ (summary.csv + per-model JSONs).
erin: top-line numbers?
sophia: MMLU deltas (FP16 -> GPTQ):
  - Llama2-13B: 71.2 -> 69.9 (-1.3)
  - Mistral-7B: 63.4 -> 63.0 (-0.4)
  - Qwen-7B: 65.7 -> 63.2 (-2.5)
HellaSwag & CodeEval follow same pattern; Qwen largest drop on instruction-following/code formatting tests.
jamal: hallucinations / safety diffs?
sophia: Qwen GPTQ: +1.8% factual hallucination rate on our curated 500-example set. Llama2: small uptick in code-formatting errors (~0.6%). Mistral: no statistically significant change.
zhao: what was the GPTQ config (group size / act-order / per-channel)?
sophia: command used: 
```
gptq_offline --model path/to/model --bits 4 --group-size 128 --per-channel true --act-order true --percdamp 0.01 --calib-batches 64
```
jamal: latency / memory numbers?
sophia: median token-step latency on A10G: Llama2 FP16 2.1ms -> GPTQ 1.8ms (lower variance); Mistral FP16 1.9ms -> GPTQ 1.7ms; Qwen FP16 2.4ms -> GPTQ 1.9ms but with higher p99 variance at seq>2048 (KV cache thrash). Memory usage down ~25% for Llama2.
erin: recommendation for deploy profiles?
sophia: Initial recs:
  - Hosted (cost-sensitive): Llama2-13B GPTQ for most traffic, enable prefix/KV caching, group-size 128.
  - Latency-critical: Mistral-7B GPTQ ok, go canary 10% then ramp.
  - Qwen-7B: keep FP16 baseline. If we try GPTQ, do a strict canary (5%) with safety gating on hallucination_count and perplexity_delta.
  - Dedicated: offer mixed slots where GPU runs GPTQ and CPU fallback uses INT8 quantized variant.
  - CI/rollouts: auto-rollback if hallucination_rate delta > 1.0% or MMLU drop > 1.5%.
jamal: good. set CI gates.
devops-bot: Canary route configured -> 5% -> qwen-gptq; monitors: hallucination_count, perplexity_delta, latency_99. Alert if any threshold exceeded.
jamal: any weird edgecases discovered?
sophia: Qwen-specific: instruction prompts containing multiple code fences produced tokenization mismatches after GPTQ; first token IDs sometimes shift leading to stray leading backticks in outputs. Workaround: normalize whitespace and ensure explicit BOS token in prompt. Also saw slight temperature sensitivity for Llama2 GPTQ in code-gen tasks.
zhao: I'll add a small preprocess hook in runtime to normalize code blocks and force BOS.
eng-runtime-bot: Opening issue #5123 to review kernel alignment and ensure act-order path is using fused kernels for group-size=128.
erin: can we get a quick cost delta estimate?
sophia: rough ballpark: ~30% per-token cost reduction for Llama2 when moving FP16 -> GPTQ on the same GPU due to higher packing and lower memory footprints. Detailed cost.csv is in S3.
jamal: ok, tagging @eng-runtime and @platform for longer-term perf tuning and a follow-up bake with different group-sizes.
sophia: thanks all — I'll drop a short RFC with the numbers + charts in Notion and link the S3 artifacts. Planning a 48h canary for Qwen if ops approves. :thumbsup:
